reviewer.scope: same-provider editorial review only; not different-provider release acceptance

items.fact_status: AFI credits Garland as Dorothy Gale in the 1939 film; Shirley Temple was considered but did not play the completed role.
items.finding: The factual answer, public revision binding, sources and distractor treatment are sound. Recast the unreferenced phrase about Dorothy's inner path as an explicit memory/reading aid, rather than a sourced factual claim.

items.fact_status: AFI credits Bogart as Rick Blaine; Henreid as Victor Laszlo and Rains as Louis Renault.
items.finding: The article wrongly says the answer options contain all actors just named: Ingrid Bergman is mentioned but is not an option, while Cary Grant is an option but omitted. Describe the actual choices accurately. Flag the public stem separately: Russian requires accusative, «кто сыграл Рика Блейна?», but do not alter it in this article batch.

items.fact_status: MTI credits James Lapine for book and Stephen Sondheim for music and lyrics; Library of Congress supports the 1986 workshop and 1987 Broadway opening dates.
items.finding: Use Russian theatrical terminology «либретто (сцены и диалоги)» instead of a bare literal «книга». Mark the statement about melody and words as an interpretive learning lens, not a documented historical claim.

items.fact_status: MTI credits George Furth for book and Stephen Sondheim for music and lyrics; Library of Congress supports the 26 April 1970 Broadway opening.
items.finding: Use «либретто (сцены и диалоги)» for Furth's role. Mark or narrow the claim that the show is not a linear romance but a sequence of musical reflections: MTI supports the birthday premise and interactions, not that interpretive formulation as a direct fact.
